subject: maths
question: The average of the ages of a husband and his wife was 25 years at the time of their wedding. After 7 years, they have a 2-year old child. What is the average age of the family at present?
solution:
Given:

The average age of a husband and his wife was 25 years at the time of their wedding. After 7 years, they have a 2-year-old child.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

The total age of the couple at the present = 25 × 2 + 7 × 2

⇒ 64 years

Number of family members = 2 + 1 = 3

Total age of all members = 64 + 2 = 66 years

Now, the average age of the family = 66/3

⇒ 22 years

∴ The average age of the family is 22 years.
